title: EC-Council Blockchain Developer
summary: EC-Council Blockchain Developer is a professional certification offered by EC-Council. This independent study guide covers all 18 course modules: Introduction to Blockchain Technology, Cryptography and Technology, Blockchain's Impact on the Financial Sector, Bitcoin, Blockchain Project Implementation, Security in Blockchain Module 07 Cryptomining, Ethereum, Other Cryptocurrencies, Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain, Blockchain as a Service (BaaS), Open-Source Business Blockchain Frameworks, Python for Blockchain, JavaScript for Blockchain, Java for Blockchain, Blockchain Online Integrated Development Environments (IDEs), Industry Use Cases, Decentralized Applications (dApps), Quantum Computing and Blockchain. Every module has a MEDIUM and a HARD scenario exam, written as realistic workplace situations rather than recall questions, so you practise applying each module the way the job asks for it.
